name: Manufacturing
shortDescription: Reliable FAS compressed air for production lines, tools, fixtures, and plant utilities.
fullDescription: firstAir FAS rotary screw compressors support everyday manufacturing needs with air cooled packages, IE3 high efficient motors, maintenance friendly access, and practical 8 to 10 bar operation.

challenges.title: Continuous Air Demand
challenges.solution: Select FAS models by kW and maximum air discharge to match daily plant air requirements.

challenges.title: Maintenance Access
challenges.solution: FAS packages use maintenance friendly layouts for practical service work.

name: Workshops
shortDescription: Compact FAS compressors for repair shops, fabrication bays, and small production areas.
fullDescription: For workshops and light industrial users, smaller FAS models provide dependable compressed air in a compact air cooled package with V-belt drive construction.

challenges.title: Limited Floor Space
challenges.solution: Use compact FAS packages from 4 kW to 11 kW for workshop air.

challenges.title: Simple Ownership
challenges.solution: Air cooled design and IE3 motors keep operation practical and economical.

name: Automotive
shortDescription: Compressed air for service centers, component manufacturing, and pneumatic shop tools.
fullDescription: firstAir FAS compressors help automotive users run air tools, service bays, assembly tasks, and support equipment with steady compressed air delivery.

challenges.title: Variable Tool Usage
challenges.solution: Choose a FAS model with enough free air delivery for peak shop demand.

challenges.title: Dependability
challenges.solution: IE3 motor and rotary screw package design supports daily service operation.

name: Packaging
shortDescription: Plant air for packaging machines, actuators, and pneumatic handling systems.
fullDescription: Packaging operations need dependable plant air for repetitive machine cycles. The FAS range provides selectable power and discharge capacity from compact to heavy duty packages.

challenges.title: Machine Uptime
challenges.solution: Match compressor capacity with connected packaging equipment and duty cycle.

challenges.title: Energy Efficiency
challenges.solution: IE3 motors help support economical operation in repeated-cycle applications.

name: General Plant Air
shortDescription: A broad FAS selection for utility compressed air across industrial facilities.
fullDescription: From 3 kW to 37 kW, firstAir FAS compressors cover general plant air needs with straightforward model selection, 8 to 10 bar operating pressure, and clear technical data.

challenges.title: Right Sizing
challenges.solution: Use the product page filters and technical data to select by power and air discharge.

challenges.title: Local Support
challenges.solution: Use the dealer network to connect with an authorized firstAir representative.
